description: This source file contains utility functions for the SuiteCRM Upgrade Wizard process, including version handling, file backups, copying, deletion, permission checks, and upgrade process coordination.

classes.name: Team
classes.description: Used within upgradeModulesForTeam() to create or update team records for users, ensuring proper team associations.

methods.name: implodeVersion
methods.description: Concatenates version parts into a string, removing beta and rc suffixes, with configurable size, delimiter, and last symbol.

methods.name: getUploadRelativeName
methods.description: Resolves the real path from an upload:// URL or local path.

methods.name: commitMakeBackupFiles
methods.description: Creates backups of files targeted for upgrade, copying them to a restore directory, with error collection.

methods.name: commitCopyNewFiles
methods.description: Copies unzipped patch files to their destination directories, handling special cases and skipping certain files.

methods.name: copyFilesOnCancel
methods.description: Placeholder for cancel action in file copy process.

methods.name: removeFileFromPath
methods.description: Deletes specific files from a directory path, optionally excluding certain files.

methods.name: copyRecursiveBetweenDirectories
methods.description: Recursively copies files between two directories, preserving their structure.

methods.name: deleteDirectory
methods.description: Deletes a directory and all its contents, optionally only emptying it.

methods.name: deleteAndOverWriteSelectedFiles
methods.description: Removes specified directories and copies files in their place, respecting certain overwrite rules.

methods.name: recursive_empty_or_remove_directory
methods.description: Recursively empties or removes a directory, excluding specified files/dirs.

methods.name: getAllCustomizedModules
methods.description: Finds modules with customized files compared to base versions.

methods.name: getAllModules
methods.description: Returns the list of all module directories.

methods.name: removeMd5MatchingFiles
methods.description: Removes files whose contents match known md5 hashes, indicating they haven't been modified.

methods.name: commitHandleReminders
methods.description: Creates tasks or emails as reminders for manual merging after upgrade.

methods.name: deleteCache
methods.description: Clears cache directories for modules, Javascript language files, smarty templates, and rebuilds dashlet cache.

methods.name: deleteChance
methods.description: Removes specific template directories and manages session variables related to chance templates.

methods.name: upgradeUWFiles
methods.description: Copies upgrade wizard related files from uploaded patches if present.

methods.name: checkCustomOverrides
methods.description: Checks for custom module files present in the upgrade package.

methods.name: upgradeUWFilesCopy
methods.description: Recursively copies upgrade wizard files into the codebase.

methods.name: getValidPatchName
methods.description: Lists valid patch files available in the upload directory.

methods.name: updateVersions
methods.description: Updates the database and files with the new version after upgrade.

methods.name: getModuleLanguagePack
methods.description: Loads language strings for a module.

methods.name: checkSystemCompliance
methods.description: Checks server environment compatibility for upgrade requirements.

methods.name: isAutoOverwriteFile
methods.description: Determines if a file is automatically overwritten during upgrade based on predefined list.

methods.name: logThis
methods.description: Logs messages to the upgradeWizard.log file.

methods.name: updateQuickCreateDefs
methods.description: Creates or modifies quickcreate view definitions for modules with customization detection.

methods.name: testPermsCreate
methods.description: Checks database privilege for CREATE TABLE.

methods.name: testPermsInsert
methods.description: Checks database privilege for INSERT.

methods.name: testPermsUpdate
methods.description: Checks database privilege for UPDATE.

methods.name: testPermsSelect
methods.description: Checks database privilege for SELECT.

methods.name: testPermsDelete
methods.description: Checks database privilege for DELETE.

methods.name: testPermsAlterTableAdd
methods.description: Checks privilege for ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN.

methods.name: testPermsAlterTableChange
methods.description: Checks privilege for ALTER TABLE CHANGE COLUMN.

methods.name: testPermsAlterTableDrop
methods.description: Checks privilege for ALTER TABLE DROP COLUMN.

methods.name: testPermsDropTable
methods.description: Checks privilege for DROP TABLE.

methods.name: getFormattedError
methods.description: Formats database errors with query information.

methods.name: getTableFromQuery
methods.description: Extracts table name from a SQL query.

methods.name: preLicenseCheck
methods.description: Performs pre-installation license and environment validation, including unzip and file validation.

methods.name: upgradeUWFiles
methods.description: ($file) extracts upgrade wizard files from a patch zip file.

methods.name: upgradeTeamColumn
methods.description: Ensures the 'team_set_id' column exists in the module's table, creates it if necessary, updates its values, and manages related vardefs and indexes.

methods.name: upgradeFolderSubscriptionsTeamSetId
methods.description: Updates folder records to set 'team_set_id' equal to 'team_id' for consistent folder security configuration.

methods.name: upgradeModulesForTeam
methods.description: For each user, creates corresponding team records if missing and updates the user's team associations, including 'team_set_id' and 'default_team'.

methods.name: addNewSystemTabsFromUpgrade
methods.description: Detects new modules added after an upgrade and adds them to system tabs configuration.

methods.name: fix_dropdown_list
methods.description: Attempts to correct incorrectly named dropdown list entries in language files, database, and vardefs, ensuring naming consistency.

methods.name: update_iframe_dashlets
methods.description: Removes certain dashlets containing SuiteCRM URLs from user preferences to update default dashlet configurations.

methods.name: convertImageToText
methods.description: Deprecated method for converting image data to text on MS SQL Server.

methods.name: clearHelpFiles
methods.description: Deletes all English inline help files from modules.

methods.name: upgradeDateTimeFields
methods.description: Updates 'date_end' fields in meetings and calls to ensure they are datetime fields, fixing bug 39757.

methods.name: upgradeDocumentTypeFields
methods.description: Sets default document types for null 'doc_type' and 'type' fields in documents and meetings.

methods.name: merge_config_si_settings
methods.description: Merges settings from 'config_si.php' into 'config.php', performing various validations and updating the config file.

methods.name: upgrade_connectors
methods.description: Handles the upgrade process for connectors, updating metadata, and removing deprecated configurations.

methods.name: remove_linkedin_config
methods.description: Removes LinkedIn-related configurations from connectors and metadata files.

methods.name: remove_linkedin_connector
methods.description: Removes LinkedIn connector files from the filesystem.

methods.name: upgradeEnableInsideViewConnector
methods.description: Activates InsideView connector across default modules, sets mappings, and updates configuration files.

methods.name: repair_long_relationship_names
methods.description: Rebuilds relationships with long names in module relationships to conform to naming constraints.

methods.name: removeSilentUpgradeVarsCache
methods.description: Deletes cached silent upgrade variables.

methods.name: loadSilentUpgradeVars
methods.description: Loads silent upgrade variables from cache or initializes empty if nonexistent.

methods.name: writeSilentUpgradeVars
methods.description: Writes silent upgrade variables to cache, creating directories if needed.

methods.name: setSilentUpgradeVar
methods.description: Sets a variable in the silent upgrade variables container.

methods.name: getSilentUpgradeVar
methods.description: Retrieves a variable from silent upgrade variables container.

methods.name: add_unified_search_to_custom_modules_vardefs
methods.description: Removes cached list of modules with unified search to force re-generation.

methods.name: unlinkUpgradeFiles
methods.description: Removes upgrade scripts and files based on version, including custom and session-specific cleanup.

methods.name: getValidDBName
methods.description: Generates valid database identifiers complying with length and character constraints.

methods.name: getUWDirs
methods.description: Returns upgrade wizard directories depending on version of the system.

methods.name: whetherNeedToSkipDir
methods.description: Checks if a directory path should be skipped based on configured skip rules.

methods.name: rebuildSprites
methods.description: Regenerates CSS sprite sheets from theme and custom directories.

methods.name: repairSearchFields
methods.description: Repairs SearchFields.php files to ensure range search attributes are correctly set.

methods.name: repairUpgradeHistoryTable
methods.description: Fixes entries in the upgrade_history table to update filename paths after an upgrade.
